name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Job lost his oxen: the Sabeans fell upon them, took them away, and slew the servants with the edge of the sword. That is problem number one.

note.label: Job 1: The Trial of an Upright Man

points: Thus saith the Lord, the labour of Egypt and the merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee in chains, and fall down and make supplication, saying surely God is in thee and there is none else. This is prophecy that the Africans, the men of stature, come over in chains, because they sold us into slavery to the so-called white man, the Grecians.

note.label: Isaiah 45: I Form the Light and Create Darkness

points: A voice of a multitude at ease was with her, and Sabeans and drunkards were brought from the wilderness who put bracelets on her hands and crowns on her head; being old in adulteries, the nations went in unto her as men go in unto a harlot.

note.label: Ezekiel 23: Aholah and Aholibah, the Two Harlot Sisters

points: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them: the Most High will raise up the Israelites from the places you sold us, back to verse 1, and bring us back to our homeland in freedom. And will return your recompence upon your own head: how did they recompense us? By selling us as slaves. So I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off. Eye for eye, tooth for tooth. For the Lord hath spoken it. Christians, you cannot change this Bible; the way they recompensed him by selling us, the same judgment comes on them.
I will raise them out of the place where ye sold them and sell your sons and daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, who sell them to the Sabeans, the Somalis, a people far off.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present
